about: Character traits (decision 'Traits': at least 250, personality, education, health, body, lifestyle and earned ones; partly inherited), plus faith and philosophy, bloodline, reputation (the designer's four new kinds, 14 Oct 2026) and bonds between two people. group (faith): religion (one, from one's people), devotion (a mystery cult) or philosophy (a school). opinion (reputation): what strangers think of the holder. skills: added to the character's skills (each 1-10, 5 ordinary). effects: what the trait does to the realm while its holder rules (the same keys as technologies: tax, research, unrest, corruption, integration, growth, siege...). opposite: traits that cannot be held together and make two people dislike each other. inherit: chance a child takes it from each parent who has it. health: death risk multiplier. fertility: chance of children multiplier.

traits.description: His house traces its line to Achilles, as the kings of Epirus did.

traits.name: Blood of Philip
traits.description: Descended from Philip of Macedon, Alexander's father.

traits.name: Blood of the Great Kings
traits.description: Claims descent from the Persian kings of Cyrus's line.

traits.name: Persian nobility
traits.description: Of one of the noble families of Persia.

traits.name: Line of Napata
traits.description: Of the royal line chosen by Amun at Napata.

traits.name: Patrician
traits.description: Of one of Rome's oldest families.

traits.name: Ancient house
traits.description: Of a house that has ruled for centuries.

traits.name: New man
traits.description: The first of his family to rise so high.

traits.name: Of two peoples
traits.description: Father of one people, mother of another.

traits.name: Line of chieftains
traits.description: Of the old chieftains of the tribe.

traits.name: Priestly family
traits.description: Of a family that holds a priesthood by birth.

traits.name: Born out of wedlock
traits.description: His father's son, but not his wife's.

traits.name: Famed
traits.description: Known across the world for great deeds.

traits.name: Feared
traits.description: Men lower their eyes when he passes.

traits.name: Notorious
traits.description: His crimes are told in every market.

traits.name: Honoured
traits.description: Known for justice and good faith.

traits.name: Respected
traits.description: A steady hand, well spoken of.

traits.name: Mocked
traits.description: A figure of fun in the comedies.

traits.name: Beloved of the people
traits.description: The people cheer him in the streets.

traits.name: Hated by the people
traits.description: The people curse his name.

traits.name: Called the Wise
traits.description: Men come from far away for his judgement.

traits.name: Known for piety
traits.description: Called pious by priests and people.

traits.name: Little known
traits.description: Few beyond his own city know his name.

bonds.name: Friend
bonds.description: Close friends, who trust each other.

bonds.name: Rival
bonds.description: Rivals for power, honour or love.

bonds.name: Student
bonds.description: Was taught by the other in youth.

bonds.name: Sworn brother
bonds.description: Swore brotherhood before the gods, as warriors did.

bonds.name: Nemesis
bonds.description: Mortal enemies; one of them will not die in bed.
